adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the diff shows a loop over `usernames.split(",")` calling `group.add(user)` for each found user, then `group.save` afterward. The diff does not show what `Group#add` does, so the claim that each add “persists immediately” and will raise on duplicates (causing a mid-loop 500 with partial membership) is not verifiable from this PR alone. However, it is still a concrete review concern that this endpoint has no transaction/rollback and no explicit handling for duplicate/already-member usernames or mid-loop failures, and the final `group.save` may not meaningfully represent the success of the membership changes depending on how `group.add` is implemented.
